<div class="card-body">
'''Nevar Yalnal''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]]<nowiki> </nowiki>([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ネヴァー・ヤルナル</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">双方のプレイヤーが同じ位置カード上にスパイを配備している時に使う。相手のスパイは運命数を引き、運命数＞２ならロストする。スパイが潜伏しているなら、運命数＞０でロストする。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">アラリア出身のラナットとしては大柄の死体あさり。金次第で誰にでもつき、部族から追放された。狡猾なスパイで、追放者。サウリンのドロイド商人、ハーチェクに雇われている。</span>''



<nowiki />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Nevar Yalnal.

'''Card text:''' Use when both players have a spy deployed on the same location card. The opponent's spy draws destiny and is lost if destiny is greater than 2. If the spy is undercover, it is lost if destiny is greater than 0.

'''Lore:''' A scavenger from Aralia who is large for a Ranat. Sides with anyone for money and was exiled from his tribe. A cunning spy and an outcast. Employed by Hrchek, a Saurin droid trader.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese text says the same location card, while the English specifies the same site. Its wording makes the opponent's spy the grammatical subject of drawing destiny; the English simply directs the player to draw destiny. The Japanese lore adds that he was exiled from his tribe.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Nevar Yalnal]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].
